subject: [PATCH fstests v2] btrfs: test graceful ENOMEM handling in synchronous dirops

2026-09-17.patch_summary: This patch adds a test case to the fstests suite that exercises the btrfs filesystem's handling of ENOMEM errors in synchronous directory operations. The test uses fault injection knobs to simulate an -ENOMEM error when creating a directory, and verifies that the operation returns ENOMEM to userspace without aborting the filesystem. The test also checks that subsequent operations, including a mount cycle with orphan cleanup and automatic fsck, complete successfully. Additionally, this patch introduces generic helpers for driving the kernel's fail_function interface in the common/inject file.
